sentences.text:
Ms. Harshlata Soni Pl appearing on behalf of Advocate   ORDER Heard and perused the case diary.
2.This is the second bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS,
2023 for grant of bail in relation to Crime No.359/2024, registered at Police Station- Bheekhangaon, District Khargone, for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 342, 376, 376-D,
376(DA), 506 of IPC 3/4 and 5l/6 of PPOCSO Act.
Applicant is in jail since 22.6.2024.
First bail application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dtd. 25.9.2024, passed in MCRC No. 41202/2024 with liberty to file afresh after three months from today.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:655 2 MCRC-322-2025 3.
Allegation against the applicant is that the applicant has committed rape with the prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and have falsely been implicated in this case.
In this case statement of prosecutrix and her parents have been recorded before the learned Trial Court and they have not supported the case of prosecution and have been declared hostile.

The applicant is a young boy aged about 23 years and is in jail since 22.6.2024 i.e.

1 more than six months.

sentences.text: Final conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
5. On the other hand, learned PL for the State has opposed the prayer.
6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which applicant may be released on bail.

Consequently,
without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this bail application filed on behalf of the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant/accused be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Fifty NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:655 3 MCRC-322-2025 Thousand only) with One solvent surety to the satisfaction of the trial Court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the BNSS, 2023.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
(PREM NARAYAN SINGH) JUDGE VD Nitesh @ Vishnu vs State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33692030/
